title: Quality record review report bundle omits the existing cycle directory
actual: The report bundle's only cycle_id source is the deficiencies list. That excludes cycles with no findings. The existing authorized cycle directory lists both the InReview and Cancelled synthetic cycles; only cycle 2 has findings.
expected: Include GET /quality/record-reviews and document its cycle_id for survey report, PDF and add-action selection, including cycles without deficiencies.
steps: As demo.quality compare GET /quality/record-reviews with GET /quality/record-review-deficiencies. Compare both with record_review_report id_sources.
evidence: DEV 2026-11-09T17:10:47.430848+00:00. Directory returned 200 for cycles 2 and 1 (6386be0cb0e14b3299ecd2c1d4dc9816). Findings returned 200 with six rows for cycle 2 (852e4002393a4545bf4b026633948de4). This is a catalogue omission; the live directory and its permissions work.
